item.title: Moderna Q1 2026 Earnings & FDA Talks
item.description:
• Summary: Moderna reported Q1 2026 earnings that beat revenue expectations, driven largely by COVID-19 vaccine sales. The company disclosed it is in active discussions with the FDA regarding Phase 4 data requirements for its updated COVID-19 vaccine. Moderna also faces ongoing litigation related to patent disputes. Despite the revenue beat, the earnings call highlighted challenges in the post-pandemic vaccine market and the company's need to diversify its pipeline. The FDA talks signal potential label expansions or new indications for its mRNA platform.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, BioPharma Dive, BioSpace

item.title: Esperion Acquisition by Archimed
item.description:
• Summary: Healthcare investment firm Archimed has agreed to acquire Esperion Therapeutics for approximately $1.1 billion, taking the company private. Esperion markets a portfolio of cardiovascular drugs, including bempedoic acid products (Nexletol, Nexlizet) for LDL cholesterol reduction. The acquisition provides Esperion with operational flexibility and capital to expand its commercial efforts. The deal underscores continued private equity interest in cardiovascular assets with established revenue streams.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, Endpoints News

item.title: Seaport Therapeutics IPO & CNS Strategy
item.description:
• Summary: Seaport Therapeutics completed its upsized initial public offering (IPO), raising $255 million, and outlined its central nervous system (CNS) strategy. The company is developing small molecules for psychiatric and neurological conditions, leveraging insights from the Karuna Therapeutics playbook. Seaport's CEO and CSO discussed their pipeline, which includes candidates for schizophrenia, depression, and anxiety. The successful IPO reflects investor appetite for CNS-focused biotech companies with novel mechanisms.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech, BioPharma Dive

item.title: Novartis US Manufacturing Expansion
item.description:
• Summary: Novartis unveiled a new active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) manufacturing plant in North Carolina, marking the final piece of its $2.3 billion US manufacturing expansion. The facility is expected to boost domestic drug production and supply chain resilience.

item.title: Amgen Repatha & Tavneos Updates
item.description:
• Summary: Amgen reported strong first-quarter results for Repatha (evolocumab) amid growing demand for PCSK9 inhibitors. Meanwhile, the company filed a label update for Tavneos (avacopan) as the FDA escalates moves to withdraw the drug following safety concerns. The updates highlight contrasting fortunes for two key Amgen products.
  • MoAs: Repatha (evolocumab): PCSK9 inhibitor that lowers LDL cholesterol. Tavneos (avacopan): Complement C5a receptor antagonist for ANCA-associated vasculitis.
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Pharma

item.title: Novo Nordisk Rybelsus Retirement
item.description:
• Summary: Novo Nordisk officially retired the Rybelsus brand in the US, consolidating its oral semaglutide product under the Ozempic label. The move aligns with the company's broader strategy to focus on the Ozempic franchise for type 2 diabetes and weight management.
  • MoAs: Rybelsus/Ozempic (semaglutide): GLP-1 receptor agonist for type 2 diabetes and obesity.
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Purdue Pharma Dissolution
item.description:
• Summary: A federal judge approved the dissolution of Purdue Pharma, the manufacturer of OxyContin, as part of a criminal sentence for its role in the opioid epidemic. The company will be dissolved and its assets used to compensate victims and fund addiction treatment.
